title: Concept Summary: Price Elasticity of Demand
content: Price elasticity of demand (PED) measures the responsiveness of quantity demanded to changes in price. When PED is greater than 1, demand is elastic; when PED is less than 1, demand is inelastic. Unit elastic demand occurs when percentage change in price equals percentage change in quantity demanded.

title: Worked Example: Market Equilibrium Computation
content: Given Qd = 100 - 2P and Qs = 20 + 2P, setting Qd = Qs yields 100 - 2P = 20 + 2P => 4P = 80 => P* = 20. Substituting into Qd yields Q* = 60 units.
